scope: real PostgreSQL, HTTP and local files

checks.name: inventory includes rules, whole skill references and binary assets
workspace metadata carries unresolved qualifications
different projects do not share rule paths or digests
unchanged registration reuses the same durable draft
concurrent freeze reuses one version and one complete snapshot
snapshot preserves binary template exactly
internal freeze does not certify official eligibility
read returns current text and fingerprint for safe editing
binary download preserves bytes and sets an attachment header
edit after freeze creates the next draft and leaves the old snapshot unchanged
stale edits are rejected without changing current bytes
workspace edit is marked different from the frozen version
old workspace digest cannot freeze newer source files
new text rule is added to the same draft
binary rule upload is stored without invoking recognition
deletion removes the working file and retains frozen history
reject protected or escaping path skill/SKILL.md
reject protected or escaping path materials/../skill/SKILL.md
reject protected or escaping path ../escaped.md
second freeze retains the previous version and captures current files
published fingerprints remain valid after PostgreSQL JSONB round trip
database manifests contain no rule or skill bodies
tampered existing snapshot prevents reuse
missing skill references block freeze for that project
another project never receives the first project versions
